title: Bigfoot
wikitext:
Danish QuakeWorld player and creator of [[fodquake]], a QuakeWorld client based on [[fuhQuake]]. Bigfoot also hosts the Asgaard servers in Nuremberg, Germany as well as the Udgaard servers in Paris, France.
